(M. Bridson). Let Fm be a free group of rank m and let ϕ ∈ Aut(Fm ) be
a polynomially growing automorphism of maximal degree m − 1, which means that
for some (equivalently, any) free basis {x1 , . . . , xm } of Fm , the sequence maxi |ϕn (xi )|
grows at the rate of nm−1 , where |g| denotes the minimal length of g in the xi and
their inverses.
    a) Is the free-by-cyclic group Fm ⋊ϕ Z virtually special?
    b) In particular, are the Hydra groups Gm = Fm ⋊ Z = ⟨a1 , . . . , am , t |
t−1 a1 t = a1 , t−1 ai t = ai ai−1 for all i > 1⟩ virtually special?               I. Soroko
